challenges.says: The title, what and why promise a single entry that takes a name or a security identifier, but the only component built (User Identification Entry) enforces just the Escape rule, so the story is a thin restatement of leaving and its criterion does not cover the entry that the title names; the name and identifier handling belongs to the Directory Account Resolver, which this story does not build, and the criteria do not say so.

The criterion adds 'and nothing is changed', which the cited rule (Escape closes the user dialog as cancelled) does not state; also 'at any time' in the what is stronger than the rule, which names only Escape, and 'security identifier' is left unexplained for a product owner.
